Rest loosely covered on a clean board for 20–30 minutes before carving. Wash the probe and utensils after contact with raw or undercooked meat. Serve with your chosen sides.

method: Heat oven to 180°C, 160°C fan. Use a fully defrosted joint. Check its packaging for any instructions that take precedence for its exact size and cut; remove packaging and pat dry. Do not wash raw poultry.

Place in a roasting tin. Mix the oil with any listed softened butter, mustard, chopped herbs, garlic, zest, salt and pepper and rub over the meat. Put any listed fruit halves or quarters, onion pieces and whole herb sprigs around the joint or inside a whole bird’s cavity. For duck, carefully spoon off excess rendered fat halfway through cooking. Keep raw-meat utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Roast for approximately 130 minutes, checking regularly towards the end and loosely covering with foil if browning too quickly. This is a guide, not a guarantee of doneness.

Check with a clean food thermometer in the thickest part, avoiding bone: the centre must reach 75°C for 30 seconds or 70°C for 2 minutes. Test poultry in more than one thick part. Continue cooking and recheck if needed.
Rest loosely covered on a clean board for 20–30 minutes before carving. Wash the probe and utensils after contact with raw or undercooked meat. Serve with your chosen sides.

ingredients: 150 g soft goat cheese labelled vegetarian
method: Fry onion in oil for 8 minutes. Add mushrooms and thyme and cook for 15–20 minutes until all liquid evaporates. Remove from heat, cool slightly, then mix in goat cheese and breadcrumbs.
Spread the filling on a clean shallow tray and let the steam subside, then chill until cold before adding pastry. A warm, wet filling makes pastry soggy.

title: Vegan pear and cranberry galette
story: Vegan pear and cranberry galette for your Christmas table. This original OPR dessert serves 8; follow the method below for quantities, cooking stages and any resting or chilling time.
ingredients: 320 g ready-rolled shortcrust pastry labelled vegan
4 ripe but firm pears, cored and thinly sliced
method: Heat oven to 200°C, 180°C fan. Put pastry on its baking paper on a large tray.
Toss pear slices and cranberries with sugar, cornflour and cinnamon. Pile onto pastry, leaving a 4 cm border.
Fold border over the edge of the fruit, pleating gently. Brush exposed pastry with soya milk.
Bake 40–45 minutes until pastry is golden underneath and fruit is tender and bubbling. Cool 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Vegan chocolate and cranberry bark
story: Vegan chocolate and cranberry bark for your Christmas table. This original OPR dessert serves 8; follow the method below for quantities, cooking stages and any resting or chilling time.
method: Line a small tray with baking paper. Melt chocolate in a dry heatproof bowl over barely simmering water; keep the bowl above the water.
Stir half the cranberries, nuts and zest into chocolate. Spread about 5 mm thick on the lined tray.
Scatter with remaining cranberries, nuts and zest and press them in lightly.
Cool, then refrigerate for 1 hour until set. Break into pieces and keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve as a small sweet finish.
